SINDH EXECUTION OF THE PUNISHMENT OF WHIPPING RULES, 1986
SINDH EXECUTION OF
THE PUNISHMENT OF WHIPPING RULES, 1986
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part IV-A, 18th December, 1986]
No. PRS/1-13/86.-- In
exercise of the powers conferred by Section 7 of the Execution of the
Punishment of Whipping Ordinance, 1979, the Government of Sindh are pleased to
make the following rules, namely:-‑
1. Short title and
commencement.-- (1) These rules may be called the Sindh Execution of the
Punishment of Whipping Rules, 1986.
(2) They shall came into force at
once.
2. Definitions.-- In these
rules unless there is anything repugnant in the - subject or context--
(a) "Government"
means the Government, of Sindh;
(b) "Ordinance"
means the Execution of the Punishment of Whipping Ordinance, 1979.
3. Panel of persons for execution
of punishment.-- (1) The Inspector-. General of Prisons shall nominate a
panel of persons from amongst Warders or other Jail Staff who possess mature
understanding and are willing to execute the punishment of whipping:
Provided that
punishment of whipping on females shall he executed by a female.
(2) The whipping on a woman shall
not be visible to or witnessed by any; male person.
4. Objection of the convict.--
The objection of the convict with regard to partiality of the person appointed
under sub-rule (1) of rule 3 shall he heard and rectified if found valid.
5. Provision for whips.--
The required number of whips of the specification mentioned in Section 4 of the
Ordinance, shall he arranged by the Inspector General of Prisons, who shall
also arrange for their proper maintenance and storage.
